title: R' Avtolos the Elder, a Tanna

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Mekhilta, Beshalach, chapter 3, according to the readings of Yalkut and the Vilna Gaon; his ‘our reading’ is R' Avshalom the Elder.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Avtolos and Avshalom the Elder are the different readings Hyman attributes to the Yalkut/Vilna Gaon and his current text.

The entire thirty-one-paragraph Beeri 2019 Mekhilta, Tractate Vayehi Beshalach 3, was read without finding this Avtolos/Avshalom designation there. This is a bounded comparison, not absence elsewhere or equivalence of chapter numbering across editions. The heading and alternative personal title use R' because Hyman abbreviates them. His Yalkut/Vilna Gaon and “our reading” statements remain reports, without fresh collation of those witnesses or an identity binding.
